versions.content: SwDataDefProps.displayFormat vs. CompuMethod.dis- playFormat If both SwDataDefProps.displayFormat and SwDataDefProps. compuMethod . displayFormat exist, then the value of SwDataDefProps.dis- playFormat shall be used and the value of SwDataDefProps.compuMethod . dis- playFormat shall be disregarded. If a value is set in only one of SwDataDefProps.displayFormat and SwDataDef- Props.compuMethod . displayFormat , then the value shall be respected.
